bio: North of St. Pete in the charming town of Safety Harbor, The Tides Market from husband-and-wife Jon and Mary Kate Walker is part bustling market and part full-service restaurant. As the location and name suggest, it's all about seafood here. From the sourcing to the execution, great care is taken with every step. The menu is large and shows off a Southern edge (fried green tomatoes and pimento cheese pop up throughout). Kick things off with oysters Bienville, a plate of broiled oysters topped with butter breadcrumbs, house andouille, shrimp, and parmesan, then tuck in to a Po'boy. You can order one with shrimp or the classic oyster, but one stuffed with fried grouper bites is a worthy order.They're open all day and offer brunch on the weekends....
